credit(address,address,uint256,bytes32,u.details: Symmetric with `debit`: pulls tokens back from the calling resolver      and re-attributes them, used for unspent draws and swap surplus.      `requestHash` and `kind` are event metadata for per-order      attribution; the pool does not validate them.

debit((address,address,uint256,address,b.details: The config-gated draw path. Every check is made here rather than in      the calling resolver, so none of them rests on resolver honesty:      the caller must hold `RESOLVER_ROLE` and be allowlisted by the      account, `authorization` must carry the account's authorizer signing      off on this specific order, each      `(orderAddress, account, legIndex)` triple funds at most one draw so      re-executing a leg can never double-draw an account, and the      per-order cap bounds the sum the account's legs draw of the token      for the order. A revert anywhere in the outer settlement unwinds the      draw records with the balances.

depositFor(address,address,uint256).details: Permissionless: anyone may top up any account. The credited amount      is the balance the pool actually received, so fee-on-transfer tokens      cannot inflate an account balance beyond the pool's holdings.

eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

setSponsorshipConfig((address,address,ad.details: Callable by anyone carrying a valid account-signed message (ERC-1271      supported), so the platform can relay and pay gas for the config of      wallets that never transact on this chain. Deliberately not paused      so an account can always tighten or revoke its guardrails.

setSponsorshipConfig(address,(uint256,ui.details: The caller configures its own account. Deliberately not paused so an      account can always tighten or revoke its guardrails.

setSponsorshipResolver((address,address,.details: Callable by anyone carrying a valid account-signed message (ERC-1271      supported), so the platform can relay and pay gas for the allowlist      of wallets that never transact on this chain. Deliberately not      paused so an account can always revoke a resolver.

setSponsorshipResolver(address,bool).details: The caller configures its own account. Deliberately not paused so an      account can always revoke a resolver.

withdraw((address,address,uint256,addres.details: Callable by anyone carrying a valid account-signed message (ERC-1271      supported), so the platform can relay and pay gas for sponsor      withdrawals. Deliberately not paused so funds can always leave the      pool.

withdraw(address,uint256,address).details: Kept for the platform's account operations; it cannot reach any      other account's balance. Deliberately not paused so funds can always      leave the pool.

WITHDRAWER_ROLE().notice: Withdraws from its own account balance without a signed message

balances(address,address).notice: Returns the pool balance a token holds for an account

constructor.notice: Creates a standalone funding pool with its initial role members

credit(address,address,uint256,bytes32,u.notice: Returns tokens from the calling resolver to an account's         balance, tagged with the order and leg kind that produced them

debit((address,address,uint256,address,b.notice: Draws from an account balance for one order leg, within the         account's sponsorship config and its authorizer's per-order         authorization

depositFor(address,address,uint256).notice: Deposits tokens from the caller into an account's pool balance

drawRecords(address,address,uint256).notice: Returns whether a leg already drew the account for an order

hashDrawAuthorization((address,address)).notice: Returns the EIP-712 digest for a per-order draw authorization

hashSponsorshipConfigUpdate((address,add.notice: Returns the EIP-712 digest for a sponsorship config update

hashSponsorshipResolverUpdate((address,a.notice: Returns the EIP-712 digest for a sponsorship resolver update

hashWithdrawal((address,address,uint256,.notice: Returns the EIP-712 digest for a pool withdrawal

orderDraws(address,address,address).notice: Returns the total an account's legs drew of a token for an order

pause().notice: Pauses pool deposits, credits, and debits; withdrawals stay open

setSponsorshipConfig((address,address,ad.notice: Sets an account's standing draw guardrails for one token         following an account-signed message

setSponsorshipConfig(address,(uint256,ui.notice: Sets the caller's standing draw guardrails for one token

setSponsorshipResolver((address,address,.notice: Allows or disallows a resolver to draw from an account's balance         following an account-signed message

setSponsorshipResolver(address,bool).notice: Allows or disallows a resolver to draw from the caller's balance

sponsorshipConfig(address,address).notice: Returns an account's standing draw guardrails for one token

sponsorshipResolvers(address,address).notice: Returns whether an account allowlists a resolver for draws

unpause().notice: Resumes pool deposits, credits, and debits

usedSponsorshipNonces(address,uint256).notice: Tracks consumed sponsorship update nonces for each account,         shared between config and resolver updates

usedWithdrawalNonces(address,uint256).notice: Tracks consumed withdrawal nonces for each account

withdraw((address,address,uint256,addres.notice: Pays out an account balance following an account-signed message
